_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Manmatha Nath Dutt (1855-1912): the prose Rāmāyana (Calcutta, 1891-94, 4 vols), the Harivamsha (1897) and the Vishnupuranam (1896, based on H. H. Wilson's translation). Not R. C. Dutt, whose verse epics are on Lane D's dutt shelf. US public domain. Round 162 (2026-10-23) added nine volumes credited "edited and published by Manmatha Nath Dutt", on Adam's ruling. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 34); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

_pending.mn-dutt-edited-and-published: Adam ruled 2026-10-23 (decision card): shelve these with honest credit. Nine are shelved in round 162. Still held, because no year (or no credit) can be read on the title page in the OCR: the Markandeya Puranam (markandeyapurana021288mbp; credit garbled), the Srimadbhagabatam DLI copy (in.ernet.dli.2015.272582; no year), Agni Puranam vol. I (in.ernet.dli.2015.279469; year garbled), Gautama Samhita (samhitasoriginal00duttuoft), Parasara Samhita (parasarasamhita00duttgoog), Manu Samhita (cu31924023014941), the Google Adi Parva (aproseenglishtr00duttgoog; a second copy anyway), and two DLI Mahabharata scans with no title page (india.history.resource.118372 Shanti, 94311 Bhishma). Not looked for yet: Bhishma Parva and the other parvas with title pages, the Rig Veda (the KSU copy's OCR is unreadable), the other Dharma Sastra samhitas. Agni Puranam vols. 2-4 DLI copies are modern reprints and refused.
